author: (Smith, 1885)

note.en: A small roughneck shrimp of mud and sand bottoms, known here from two 1971 museum specimens taken at 19 m southeast of Limón.
note.es: Un camarón pequeño de fondos de fango y arena, conocido aquí por dos ejemplares de museo de 1971 tomados a 19 m al sureste de Limón.

evidence: GBIF/OBIS: 2 USNM specimens, 19 m southeast of Limón (1971)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro
